title: Accounts Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant

Location: Widnes

Position Type: Full-time, Contract

Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 per annum

Reporting To: Finance Manager

Job Summary

An adaptable and detail-focused Accounts Assistant is required to join a growing finance function based in Warrington. This varied role supports both purchase and sales ledgers, bank reconciliations, and general ledger journal postings, serving as a key operational link between daily transactional accounting and month-end financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities
- Ledger Maintenance: Assisting with the end-to-end processing of purchase invoices, matching purchase orders, and processing sales invoices and credit notes.
- Bank Reconciliations: Performing daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts, ensuring all receipts and payments are matched accurately.
- Credit Control Support: Monitoring debtor aging, performing light debt collection, and assisting with customer account allocations and query resolution.
- Payment Runs: Assisting with weekly and monthly BACS payment runs for trade creditors and staff expenses.
- Month-End Assistance: Preparing basic journal entries (prepayments, accruals, and nominal ledger adjustments) to support month-end balance sheet reconciliations.
- VAT & Compliance: Assisting in the preparation of quarterly UK VAT returns and maintaining compliant digital records under Making Tax Digital (MTD).
- Ad-Hoc Support: Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team, including supplier queries and audit file preparation.

Person Specification

Required Skills & Experience:
- Minimum 1-2 years of experience within a broad, transactional finance or accounts assistant role.
- Solid understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, nominal ledgers, and trial balances.
- Proficiency in accounting ERP software (e.g., Sage 50/200, Xero, SAP, or Business Central).
- Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills (vlookups, pivot tables, basic formatting, and sum formulas).
- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail when managing high volumes of data.

Key Competencies:
- Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication with internal department heads and external clients.
- Organisation: Strong time management skills with the ability to balance daily transactional duties with month-end deadlines.
- Proactivity: Strong problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn wider management accounting processes.

Desirable Criteria:
- Currently studying towards or holds AAT Level 2 / 3 / 4 qualifications

An exciting opportunity for an experienced Payroll Administrator to join an established payroll team within a growing organisation.

You'll support the accurate and timely delivery of UK payroll, working closely with the Payroll Manager and wider business to ensure employees are paid correctly and all statutory requirements are met.

- Knowledge of pensions and auto-enrolment.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using payroll systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Good communication and problem-solving skills.
- Able to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
